# esa++

> Python library for PowerWorld Simulator, through SimAuto. Read and write data as pandas
> DataFrames, run any script command, and get transient stability results as NumPy arrays.
> Every object type and field is typed.

Install with `pip install esapp`. It needs Windows, PowerWorld Simulator with SimAuto, and
Python 3.12 to 3.14. Open a session with `with PowerWorld("case.pwb") as pw:`. Read with
`pw[Bus, fields, where]` and write with `pw[...] = value`; columns are PowerWorld field names,
keys first. Object types and fields are classes in `esapp.grid` (`Bus.BusPUVolt`), and lists
such as `Gen.BidCurve` read and write the same way. Analyses are attributes of the session:
pw.pf, pw.ctg, pw.sens, pw.groups, pw.pv, pw.opf, pw.atc, pw.qv, pw.gic, pw.fault, pw.files,
pw.log and pw.ts. Build contingencies with `esapp.ctg`. `pw.pf.ybus()`, `pw.pf.jacobian()` and
`pw.gic.gmatrix()` return labelled SciPy sparse matrices (`pip install esapp[sparse]`).

## Docs

- [Start here](https://esapp.readthedocs.io/en/stable/): installation and a quickstart
- [Guide](https://esapp.readthedocs.io/en/stable/guide.html): basics, reading, writing, selecting, analyses, matrices, transient stability, commands, errors, testing
- [Examples: Data](https://esapp.readthedocs.io/en/stable/examples/data/index.html): data access, grid construction, grid maps, script commands
- [Examples: Steady state](https://esapp.readthedocs.io/en/stable/examples/steady_state/index.html): power flow, network matrices, sensitivities, contingencies, optimal power flow, transfer capability, faults, GIC
- [Examples: Stability](https://esapp.readthedocs.io/en/stable/examples/stability/index.html): PV and QV curves
- [Examples: Dynamics](https://esapp.readthedocs.io/en/stable/examples/dynamics/index.html): transient stability, frequency response, contingency sweeps
- [API: Data](https://esapp.readthedocs.io/en/stable/api/data/index.html): `PowerWorld`, the schema, errors
- [API: Steady state](https://esapp.readthedocs.io/en/stable/api/steady_state/index.html): pw.pf, pw.sens, pw.groups, pw.ctg, pw.opf, pw.atc, pw.fault, pw.gic, pw.files, pw.log
- [API: Stability](https://esapp.readthedocs.io/en/stable/api/stability/index.html): pw.pv, pw.qv
- [API: Dynamics](https://esapp.readthedocs.io/en/stable/api/dynamics.html): pw.ts, events, results, stores
- [API: Integration](https://esapp.readthedocs.io/en/stable/api/integration/index.html): SimAuto, testing

## Optional

- [Objects & Fields](https://esapp.readthedocs.io/en/stable/catalog/objects.html): every type in esapp.grid, and what a transient simulation can record
- [Script commands](https://esapp.readthedocs.io/en/stable/catalog/commands.html): every script command with its parameters
- [Changelog](https://esapp.readthedocs.io/en/stable/development/changelog.html): what changed in each release
- [Source](https://github.com/BirchfieldResearchGroup/esapp/tree/main/src/esapp): the package and its docstrings
